view_note: Serial projects ahead of the clusters at Delaney, Sun Valley and Redhawk total 4.65 GW, but carry only one shared system upgrade: the ~$7.8M Liberty–Hassayampa Tap 230 kV rebuild. It is assigned to the 2021 Spring Cluster, and about 93% of it falls on suspended Q377, Q378 and Q379 at Sun Valley. Everything else is POI switchyard work of $0.7–4.7M per project.
